extraction_caveats: 1. The maintenance schedule is presented as milestone columns (5,000 / 7,500 / 10,000 / 15,000 … 120,000 mi) rather than a simple repeating interval table; intervals above are derived by identifying the repeating pattern across those columns. 2. The standard schedule 'Automatic transmission fluid' replacement is conditional: replace only if CONSULT deterioration data exceeds 77,000 — otherwise inspect only. 3. Engine coolant first replacement is at 105,000 mi / 84 months; subsequent interval is every 75,000 mi / 60 months per footnote on page 497. 4. Spark plugs replacement interval is stated only once at 105,000 mi / 84 months; no subsequent interval is given in the provided pages. 5. Differential gear oil and transfer fluid capacities are not listed in the provided pages (only transfer fluid capacity of 1-5/8 qt is given on page 502). 6. Intelligent Key battery appears in the standard schedule as inspect at 22,500 mi/18 mo and replace at 45,000 mi/36 mo, 67,500 mi/54 mo (inspect), 90,000 mi/72 mo, 112,500 mi/90 mo; the pattern is roughly every 22,500 mi for check/replace. 7. Pages 544–547 are index pages; no new maintenance data was extracted from them. 8. Power steering fluid and windshield-washer fluid are listed as general maintenance items (*) with no fixed mileage interval in the provided pages. 9. The severe brake fluid interval appears to be every 10,000 mi/12 mo based on the severe schedule milestones (10,000/20,000/30,000/etc.).

Automatic transmission fluid (standard replace at 30,000): removed as separate item — the 30,000 mi standard entry is conditional (inspect via CONSULT, replace only if deterioration >77000), already captured by the ATF inspect item. No unconditional ATF replacement exists in the standard schedule.
